# Scenario: project without proxy still runs; no Nginx conf is generated for it.
# README worker example: omit proxy → compose up only; sibling with proxy keeps routing.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: worker without proxy'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-worker-bot
docker-assert-no-public-ports apinfra_e2e-worker-bot

exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-worker.conf

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-worker
    enabled: true
    config: {}

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-worker/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  bot:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- .env --
